predecessors.name: Kediri Kingdom
predecessors.text: Tumapel (present-day Malang), where Ken Arok 'rose from being a servant of Tunggul Ametung, a regional ruler in Tumapel'; Kediri itself became a fief

successors.name: Majapahit
successors.text: Raden Vijaya 'ascended the throne as Kertajasa Jayawardhana, the first king of the great Majapahit Empire, on 12 November 1293'

ledger.x: 1222: Ken Arok defeats Kertajaya of Kediri at Ganter and founds Singhasari at Tumapel.

c. 1285: Madura joins Singhasari. 'Other areas in Madura Island and Borneo also offered their submission to Kertanagara.' The Singhasari page names Arya Viraraja as 'a regent from Sumenep on the island of Madura'. No state is named on Madura.

c. 1290: the Pamalayu expedition brings Melayu under Singhasari. 'Around 1290, he launched the Pamalayu expedition to Sumatra'; 'The Melayu Kingdom in eastern Sumatra came under control'. The Singhasari page dates the launch to 1275 ('In the year 1275, King Kertanegara... launched a naval campaign toward the weak…

1292: the fief of Kediri ends when its ruler Jayakatwang rebels and kills Kertanagara; the Kediri Kingdom article, cited in the kediri-kingdom dossier, has 'In 1292, Jayakatwang rebelled against Singhasari'.
1292: Singhasari's overlordship of Melayu ends with the kingdom.

wars.name: Battle of Ganter
wars.outcome: Ken Arok of Tumapel defeats Kertajaya and founds Singhasari; Kediri becomes a fief.

wars.name: Pamalayu expedition
wars.outcome: A Javanese naval expedition to Sumatra under Admiral Mahesa Anabrang; Melayu came under Singhasari control, the 'weak remains of the Srivijaya' being the target.

wars.name: Bali expedition of 1284
wars.outcome: Bali subjected to vassalage (Kertanagara page) or integrated into the realm (Bali Kingdom page); independent again in 1292.

wars.name: Mongol demand for tribute
wars.outcome: Kertanagara refused tribute in 1289 and disfigured the Mongol envoy; the Mongol fleet reached Tuban in early 1293, after his death, and was used and then expelled by Raden Vijaya.

wars.name: Jayakatwang's revolt
wars.outcome: Jayakatwang kills Kertanagara and holds the realm for about a year as restored Kediri; Singhasari ends.

certainty.note: No page gives a boundary; the extent beyond Tumapel is Cliopatria's.
